name: end_call
description: Closes the call session in an orderly way.
notes: This is always the last tool executed in any terminal flow.
Make sure all required updates have been completed before end_call.

name: callback
description: Authorized tool for escalating the conversation to a human call. It must be called when the flow cannot resolve something on its own (no availability, the booking fails repeatedly, a piece of information remains ambiguous, or the user explicitly asks to speak with a person). It only validates and normalizes the request — it does not send any email or create any task; the actual notification mechanism is executed by a subsequent step in the flow.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: if the active flow node is C__CB_RUN, execute this tool immediately — execution on this node is mandatory, without exception. Also execute it when get_available_slots returns no availability after several attempts, when book_appointment fails repeatedly, when a piece of information remains ambiguous after retrying, or when the user explicitly asks to speak with a person.
ARGUMENT RULE: contact_name is always required. You must send at least one of contact_phone and contact_email — you do not need to send both, but do not send neither.
ARGUMENT RULE: reason must be one of the 5 exact values listed below — map the actual flow situation to the closest one; do not invent another value.

ARGUMENT RULE: if the user mentions a preferred day, send it in preferred_days — accepts one day, multiple days separated by commas, or shortcuts such as 'weekdays'/'weekend'. If the user mentions a time range, map it to morning/midday/afternoon/evening in preferred_time_window. Neither is mandatory — if the user did not provide a preference, do not send them (or send 'any').

ARGUMENT RULE: iana_timezone is required and must be the same IANA timezone already determined for the user (the same one you would use for get_available_slots) — do not ask for it again if you already have it.
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use 'errors' as the sole indicator that the request is incomplete or malformed — if it is null, the request is ready for the flow to escalate.

POST-EXECUTION RULE: after a successful execution (errors is null), inform the user that someone will contact them and close that branch of the conversation warmly — do not continue trying to resolve yourself what prompted the callback.

POST-EXECUTION RULE: if errors is not null, the data indicated in the message is missing or invalid — collect or correct it with the user and call the tool again before considering the request complete.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Full name of the contact as mentioned during the call.

inputs.name: contact_phone
inputs.description: Contact's phone number in international format. At least one of contact_phone and contact_email must be provided. e.g. +573001234567

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Contact's email address. At least one of contact_phone and contact_email must be provided. e.g. maria@example.com

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Callback reason. One of: no_availability (no availability was found), booking_failed (the booking failed repeatedly), user_requested (the user asked to speak with a person), ambiguous_data (a piece of information remained ambiguous after several attempts), technical_error (technical error during the flow).

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Short summary of what happened in the conversation, so the person calling does not do so blindly. e.g. 'No availability was found in the next 14 days'

inputs.name: preferred_days
inputs.description: Day or days when the user prefers to be called. Accepts one day, multiple days separated by commas, a list, or the shortcuts 'weekdays' / 'weekend' / 'any' (no preference). e.g. 'weekdays', 'monday,wednesday'

inputs.name: preferred_time_window
inputs.description: Time window when the user prefers to be called. One of: morning, midday, afternoon, evening, any.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Standard IANA timezone identifier for the user — the same one already determined for get_available_slots. Examples: 'America/Bogota', 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'Europe/Madrid', 'Asia/Tokyo'.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean value indicating whether the tool executed successfully.

outputs.name: contact_name
outputs.description: Echo of the received name. null if the request was rejected.

outputs.name: contact_phone
outputs.description: Echo of the received phone number.

outputs.name: contact_email
outputs.description: Echo of the received email address.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.description: Normalized echo of the reason (lowercase).

outputs.name: context
outputs.description: Echo of the received context.

outputs.name: preferred_days
outputs.description: Normalized list of days (Monday through Sunday, in that order), with shortcuts already expanded. Empty array ([]) if no preference was provided or 'any' was provided.

outputs.name: preferred_time_window
outputs.description: Normalized echo of the time window. null if no preference was provided or 'any' was provided.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the received timezone.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Explains why the request was rejected (missing or invalid data: contact_name, contact_phone/contact_email, reason, iana_timezone, preferred_days, or preferred_time_window). null when the request is ready to be escalated.

name: time_now
description: Authorized tool for getting the real current date and time in the given timezone. Its response is the flow's only authorized time reference.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: when a node declares EXECUTE: time_now, call it as the first action of the turn — imperative, no exception.

ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: FORBIDDEN to deduce, estimate, or assume the current date or time from the model's knowledge, training, or conversational context. Do not speak or route before capturing the 'now' field.
ARGUMENT RULE: iana_timezone is an IANA continent/city identifier (e.g. America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/Sao_Paulo). Send whatever the flow fixes; never use abbreviations (EST, COT, BRT).
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use the 'now' field as the only authorized time reference. To normalize a relative date ('8 months ago', 'last year'), compute it from 'now'.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'now' comes back null or 'errors' is not null, call the tool again before continuing.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA identifier of the timezone the current time is wanted in (continent/city). Examples: America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/Sao_Paulo.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the query ran successfully.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the IANA timezone identifier used.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: Current date and time in the given timezone, ISO 8601 with offset. Example: 2026-08-28T18:18:28.935329-05:00. null on error.

outputs.name: calendar
outputs.description: The next 21 days starting today in the given timezone, as 'YYYY-MM-DD Weekday' entries separated by commas (e.g. '2026-10-27 Tuesday, 2026-10-28 Wednesday'). Use it to resolve weekday names and relative days ('Wednesday', 'tomorrow') to a calendar date. null on error.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the query failed. null on success.

name: update_custom_field
description: Actualiza un campo personalizado (Custom Field de contacto) o un valor personalizado (Custom Value global) en GoHighLevel.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: cuando el usuario pide cambiar una preferencia personalizada como su idioma, o una configuración global de la subcuenta.
ARGUMENTS: name (nombre legible como 'language' o ID técnico), value (nuevo valor).
CONTEXT RULE: provee contactId para cambios específicos del usuario; si se omite pero se da locationId, actualiza un valor global (Custom Value).
SOURCE OF TRUTH: usa success para confirmar que GHL aceptó el cambio.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Nombre o ID del campo/valor a actualizar. Ejemplo: 'language', 'uWLes...'.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Nuevo valor a asignar. Ejemplo: 'Spanish', 'English'.

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: ID del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.contact_id). Si se provee, se actualiza su campo personalizado.

inputs.name: location_id
inputs.description: ID de la ubicación en GHL (disponible en context.location_id). Necesario para valores globales o para buscar campos por nombre.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Indica si la operación fue exitosa.

outputs.name: type
outputs.description: Indica qué se actualizó: 'contact' (campo de usuario) o 'custom_value' (global).

outputs.name: field_id
outputs.description: ID técnico del campo/valor actualizado.

outputs.name: field_name
outputs.description: Eco del nombre del campo solicitado.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Eco del valor asignado.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si la operación falló.

name: calculate_bmi
description: Authorized tool to calculate BMI; single source of truth for [imc].
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: upon entering Q__SQ_CALCULATE_BMI.
ARGUMENTS: weight_kg (kg), height_cm (cm); convert if input is in lbs/ft.
RULE: do not compute manually nor confirm before capturing [imc].
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use [imc] only; never recalculate manually.

inputs.name: weight_kg
inputs.description: Candidate's current weight in kilograms, from the captured weight slot.

inputs.name: height_cm
inputs.description: Candidate's current height in centimeters, from the captured height slot.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the computation executed successfully.

outputs.name: imc
outputs.description: Decimal BMI value. null if weight_kg or height_cm were invalid.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message when weight_kg or height_cm are invalid. null on success.

name: get_available_slots
description: Authorized availability; single source of truth for days and times.
notes: ARGUMENTS: calendar_type is REQUIRED and is always 'FT' (the BabyNova calendar). The tool fails without it.
MANDATORY EXECUTION: upon entering S__SC_AVAIL/AM_RESCHED_AV and in any attempt to schedule/reschedule/see-more/retry.
ARGUMENTS: iana_timezone = 'America/Bogota' (fixed).
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use only available_slots with start_co/end_co and start_local/end_local.
PRESENTATION: speak with start_local/end_local; start_co/end_co are internal.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Calendar to use. Always the literal 'FT'; the tool fails if it is missing.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA (continent/city) timezone identifier for the user. Fixed value for this agent: America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the query executed successfully. Does not by itself indicate availability — check available_slots.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the IANA identifier used to compute start_local/end_local.

outputs.name: available_slots
outputs.description: Array of objects with available slots. Each object has start_co/end_co (Colombia time, ISO 8601) and start_local/end_local (contact's timezone, ISO 8601). Empty array ([]) when no availability.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the query failed. null when successful, even if available_slots is empty.

name: book_appointment
description: Authorized booking; creates the appointment from a valid slot.
notes: ARGUMENTS: calendar_type is REQUIRED and is always 'FT' (the BabyNova calendar). The tool fails without it.
MANDATORY EXECUTION: upon entering S__SC_BOOK; requires prior get_available_slots.
ARGUMENTS: start_date = slot.start_co; duration = <APPOINTMENT_DURATION_MINUTES>; iana_timezone = 'America/Bogota'; confirmed contact_name/email/phone.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: confirm only if success == true and event_id != null.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Calendar to use. Always the literal 'FT'; the tool fails if it is missing.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: Start datetime in ISO 8601 with offset. Literal copy of start_co from the chosen slot in available_slots.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Appointment duration in minutes, sent as string. Fixed for this flow: <APPOINTMENT_DURATION_MINUTES>.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Contact's full name, already confirmed in the flow.

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Contact's email in lowercase, already confirmed in the flow. Used to send the appointment confirmation.

inputs.name: contact_phone
inputs.description: Contact's phone number in E.164 international format, already confirmed in the flow.

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: CRM contact the appointment belongs to: the conversation's {{contact.contact_id}}. Required: the tool fails without it, and it never looks a contact up by e-mail or phone.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone identifier of the contact; fixed value 'America/Bogota'.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the booking was created successfully.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.description: Rejection reason when success is false: 'invalid_start_date', 'past_date', 'invalid_hour', 'creation_failed', 'slot_taken'. null when success is true.

outputs.name: event_id
outputs.description: Identifier of the created event. null if booking was not completed.

outputs.name: event_link
outputs.description: Calendar event link. null if booking was not completed.

outputs.name: meet_link
outputs.description: Video-call link for the appointment. null if booking was not completed.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Technical error message. May be present with success == true if the appointment was created but email notification failed.

name: find_appointment
notes: ARGUMENTS: calendar_type is REQUIRED and is always 'FT' (the BabyNova calendar). The tool fails without it.
MANDATORY EXECUTION: when the contact requests to consult/verify appointment details.
ARGUMENTS: contact_name and/or calendar_phone/contact_email; optional iana_timezone.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: appointments; empty -> no records.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Calendar to use. Always the literal 'FT'; the tool fails if it is missing.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Contact's full name to perform the search.

inputs.name: calendar_phone
inputs.description: Contact's mobile phone to perform the search.

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Contact's email to perform the search.

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: CRM contact the appointment belongs to: the conversation's {{contact.contact_id}}. Required: the tool fails without it, and it never looks a contact up by e-mail or phone.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone to display times for the found appointments. Default: America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean indicating whether the search completed.

outputs.name: appointments
outputs.description: List of objects with information about found appointments (event_id, summary, start_time).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the search failed.

name: cancel_appointment
notes: ARGUMENTS: calendar_type is REQUIRED and is always 'FT' (the BabyNova calendar). The tool fails without it.
MANDATORY EXECUTION: with confirmed event_id (from find_appointment).
ARGUMENTS: exact event_id; optional iana_timezone.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use success as the sole verdict.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Calendar to use. Always the literal 'FT'; the tool fails if it is missing.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Unique Google Calendar event identifier to cancel.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Contact's IANA timezone. Default: America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean indicating whether the cancellation was successful.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the cancellation failed.

name: edit_appointment
notes: ARGUMENTS: calendar_type is REQUIRED and is always 'FT' (the BabyNova calendar). The tool fails without it.
MANDATORY EXECUTION: when changing date/time/duration of a scheduled appointment.
ARGUMENTS: exact event_id; optional new_start_date (from availability), new_duration, and iana_timezone.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use success as the verdict; message/new_start_time/new_duration are supportive.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Calendar to use. Always the literal 'FT'; the tool fails if it is missing.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Unique Google Calendar event identifier to modify.

inputs.name: new_start_date
inputs.description: New datetime in ISO 8601 with offset. Required if the time is being changed.

inputs.name: new_duration
inputs.description: New duration in minutes (as string). Required if duration is being changed.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Contact's IANA timezone. Default: America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean indicating whether the modification was successful.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Confirmation message for the change performed.

outputs.name: new_start_time
outputs.description: Formatted datetime if there was a time change.

outputs.name: new_duration
outputs.description: New appointment duration in minutes if modified (sent as string).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the modification failed.

name: check_adres
description: Authorized tool that checks the health-system (EPS) affiliation of a person in ADRES/BDUA from the identity document. Its output is the source of truth for the affiliation.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: trigger on entering node Q__SQ_CHECK_ADRES, and only when document_type and document_number are both known.

ARGUMENT RULE: document_type is 'CC' for a cédula de ciudadanía and 'PPT' for a permiso por protección temporal. document_number is sent as the person gave it (3 to 30 characters); spaces, dots and dashes are ignored.
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use found, has_active_affiliation and affiliations as the only affiliation data. An affiliation is active when its active field is true.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: found == false means the document is not registered in BDUA; it is not an error and means no active affiliation.

POST-EXECUTION RULE: if success == true and errors has text, the input was invalid; if success == false it is a technical failure. In both cases conclude nothing about the affiliation (the flow records unknown).
PRIVACY RULE: the result includes personal data (name, municipality, EPS); use it only for this flow and never repeat it to the candidate.

inputs.name: document_type
inputs.description: Document type: CC or PPT.

inputs.name: document_number
inputs.description: Document number, 3 to 30 characters.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Whether the lookup ran correctly from the technical point of view.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: false when the document is not registered in BDUA; null when it could not be checked.

outputs.name: has_active_affiliation
outputs.description: true when any affiliation is still active; null when it could not be checked.

outputs.name: affiliations
outputs.description: List of affiliations; each one has entity (EPS name), regime (CONTRIBUTIVO or SUBSIDIADO), status, effective_date, termination_date, affiliate_type and active. Empty when found is false.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Technical or validation error message. null on success.

name: surrogate_classification
description: Authorized final classification tool for medical and demographic eligibility. Its response is the only authorized source to resolve if the candidate is approved, rejected or inconclusive.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: execute this tool immediately upon reaching node Q__SQ_RUN_CLASSIFICATION — imperative, without exception — with all the data collected up to that point.
ARGUMENTS: send captured fields as-is; empty when missing. Do not invent values. bmi must be copied literally from calculate_bmi.
ARGUMENT RULE: city must be one of: Bogotá, Soacha, Zipaquirá, Chía, Mosquera, Funza, Cajicá, Madrid, La Calera, Cota, Facatativá, Sibaté, or 'Otro'. Any other city rejects the candidate by city.
ARGUMENT RULE: birth_type ('csection' or 'natural') is only required when the last birth was less than 18 months ago; otherwise it may be empty.
ARGUMENT RULE: document_type is 'cedula_ciudadania', 'ppt' or 'other'. Only the first two are accepted.
ARGUMENT RULE: abortions, preeclampsia, eps_active_affiliation, drug_use and availability accept 'si'/'no', 'yes'/'no', 'true'/'false' or '1'/'0', case-insensitive.
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use 'result' as the only authorized verdict. Nationality is recorded but never rejects. Do not replace this decision with agent heuristics.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'result' is 'Inconclusive', request or reconfirm the missing data before calling the tool again.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'result' starts with 'Rejected', communicate it with empathy and do not continue the qualification. If it is 'Approved', continue to the questions and scheduling step.

inputs.name: age
inputs.description: Candidate age in years. Numeric value when it exists.

inputs.name: city
inputs.description: Candidate city of residence in Colombia. Must be one of the allowed cities or Otro.

inputs.name: nationality
inputs.description: Nationality as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Recorded only; never rejects.

inputs.name: number_of_children
inputs.description: Number of children born alive. Numeric value when it exists.

inputs.name: last_birth_date
inputs.description: Date of the last birth, YYYY-MM-DD (also accepts YYYY/MM/DD). Empty when it does not exist.

inputs.name: birth_type
inputs.description: Type of the last birth: csection or natural. Required only when the last birth was less than 18 months ago.

inputs.name: number_of_c_sections
inputs.description: Total number of C-sections. Use 0 when none.

inputs.name: abortions
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has had an abortion. Recorded only.

inputs.name: preeclampsia
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has a history of preeclampsia.

inputs.name: bmi
inputs.description: Body mass index calculated by calculate_bmi. Never estimated by hand.

inputs.name: document_type
inputs.description: Identity document: cedula_ciudadania, ppt or other.

inputs.name: eps_active_affiliation
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has an active EPS affiliation (from check_adres).

inputs.name: drug_use
inputs.description: Whether the candidate uses or has used psychoactive substances.

inputs.name: availability
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has time available to attend the medical appointments.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Whether the classification was executed correctly.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Final classification: 'Approved', 'Inconclusive', 'Rejected (Age)', 'Rejected (Timing)', 'Rejected (City)', 'Rejected (Children)', 'Rejected (C-Sections)', 'Rejected (Preeclampsia)', 'Rejected (BMI)', 'Rejected (Documentation)', 'Rejected (EPS)', 'Rejected (Drug Use)' or 'Rejected (Availability)'.

outputs.name: eligibility_result
outputs.description: Eligibility value for the GHL field: 'approved', 'rejected' or 'inconclusive'.

outputs.name: eligibility_reason
outputs.description: Reason for the GHL field: 'age', 'timing', 'city', 'children', 'c_sections', 'preeclampsia', 'bmi', 'documentation', 'eps', 'drug_use', 'availability' when rejected, 'missing_data' when inconclusive, 'none' when approved.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Technical error message if classification failed. null in case of success.
